physicalNotes: Radius 1.444 +/- 0.034 solar radii from Chakrabarty & Sengupta 2019, the stellar radius of the default parameter set of WASP-33 b in the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2019AJ....158...39C/abstract): 1,004,591 km at 695,700 km per solar radius. Mass 1.495 +/- 0.031 solar masses from Chakrabarty & Sengupta 2019, the stellar mass of the default parameter set of WASP-33 b in the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2019AJ....158...39C/abstract); GM is that mass times the JPL solar GM. Temperature 7430 +/- 100 K from Chakrabarty & Sengupta 2019, the stellar temperature of the default parameter set of WASP-33 b in the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2019AJ....158...39C/abstract). presentationUp: the display axis is a sky-plane convention; the spin axis's position angle on the sky is not measured.
